title: Constitutional Amendments
description: Quiz on amendment procedures, thresholds, and constitutional evolution.

questions.question: True or False: Entrenched clauses may require stricter approval.
questions.explanation: Entrenchment adds procedural rigidity for core principles.

questions.question: Select amendment safeguard mechanisms.
questions.explanation: Procedural hurdles and review balance flexibility and stability.

questions.question: Risk of overly rigid amendment rules:
questions.explanation: Excess rigidity can hinder necessary reforms.

questions.question: Sunset clauses in amendments can:
questions.explanation: Sunsets enable reassessment of transitional provisions.

questions.question: Judicial role post-amendment may include:
questions.explanation: Courts may test conformity with unamendable principles.
